summary: Verified all 6 batched changes (SENDER_EMAIL, seller invite email rewrites, new express-interest endpoint, reservation explainer on landing + agreement, how-it-works/benefits copy edits). Added 11 new backend tests; all 25 backend tests pass. Full UI test of landing page + agreement page interest flow + reload-persistence passed.
critical_code_review_comments: leads.py _render_seller_invite still has <title>Sign your Seller Survey Agreement</title> in the email <head>. Not visible to the user in most clients but worth aligning with the new H1 to keep test grep coverage stable.

express-interest endpoint silently swallows any Resend send exception (logger.exception only) — by design and matches accept/decline, but worth surfacing in response payload like leads endpoints do if Gazeal ops want visibility on send failures.

ReservationExplainer reads token from props but the express-interest POST has no auth — anyone with a token can mark interest. Acceptable given tokens are 11-char random urlsafe, but rate-limiting may be worth adding.
test_credentials: n/a — all endpoints under test are unauthenticated; agreement tokens minted via POST /api/leads/order-survey
seed_data_creation: Created a single pending agreement token (b3C_6hnbD3I) via POST /api/leads/order-survey on localhost:8001 for UI flow. The token is now in 'expressed' state after the interest submit test (still pending for accept/decline).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/ has 25 tests covering: SENDER_EMAIL env, _render_seller_invite HTML content (heading 'Re: The Sale of …', no old H1 in body, no 'authorises RPSA' block, new one-line intro, 'What happens after' eyebrow, point 1 updated, no 'You pay nothing on signing'), order-survey response shape, express-interest first/second/404, original 14 agreement accept/decline/idempotency/409/404 cases. UI flow validated on landing + /agreement/<token>.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. Only test-side adjustment: the new one-line intro in the email HTML is wrapped across two source lines with whitespace, so the test normalises whitespace before substring match. Initial Playwright check used inner_text() which dropped the absolutely-positioned 'Recommended' badge text; switched to text_content() in the verification run.
